title: n-th Tropical Nevanlinna Theory
summary: In this paper, the tropical Nevanlinna theory is extended for piecewise polynomial continuous functions. By constructing the $n$-th Poisson-Jensen formula, the $n$-th tropical counting, proximity, and characteristic functions are introduced, which have some different properties compared to the classical tropical setting. Then, not only is the $n$-th version of the second main theorem for tropical homogeneous polynomials obtained, but also a tropical second main theorem for ordinary Fermat type polynomials is acquired.
